mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_schedule_master ( schedule_master_id, site_id, menu_id, master_title, master_content, use_yn, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{scheduleMasterId}, #{siteId}, #{menuId}, #{masterTitle}, #{masterContent}, #{useYn}, #{deleteYn}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_schedule_master SET site_id=#{siteId}, menu_id=#{menuId}, master_title=#{masterTitle}, master_content=#{masterContent}, use_yn=#{useYn}, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_ip=#{updatedIp}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE schedule_master_id = #{scheduleMasterId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

UPDATE tb_schedule_master SET master_title = #{masterTitle}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE schedule_master_id = #{scheduleMasterId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_schedule_master SET use_yn = #{useYn}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE schedule_master_id = #{scheduleMasterId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_schedule_master SET delete_yn = 'Y', use_yn = 'N', updated_at = NOW() WHERE schedule_master_id = #{scheduleMasterId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_schedule_master WHERE delete_yn = 'Y' AND updated_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
